mentions.name: hns
mentions.description: A local CLI tool for speech-to-text in the terminal in 5 keystrokes. It records the user's voice, transcribes it locally using faster-whisper, and copies the transcription to the clipboard. The author uses it with Claude Code to dictate long, detailed context instead of typing it out.
mentions.problem: Typing out all one's thoughts and detailed context is slow compared to speaking them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
